text:
Situation: Neostigmine methylsulfate injection is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-01-12. Corvale East holds 57 vials (15 days on hand). Corvale General holds 109 vials (28.1 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows neostigmine methylsulfate is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The label for NDC 00641615010 names Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) as the registered plant with a last inspection classified NAI on 2026-05-13. FDA inspection records for that plant show multiple VAI classifications from 2009 through 2024.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. No manufacturer is currently on FDA's shortage list for this product. The ranked supplier options are not on the shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as the primary alternate source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as secondary alternate source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary alternate source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and manufacturer communications weekly; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to review inventory thresholds and reorder points for both campuses; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose conservation measures at this time.
